title: Cross-validate: compression parity
description: Cross-validate compression output across Python/Rust/Zephyr implementations. Acceptance: bit-identical output for same input across all implementations.
notes: Implemented an authoritative bounded cross-language compression gate driven by format_version 2 test/vectors/schc_compression.json. The strict generator rejects duplicate keys, unknown categories/fields, invalid types/ranges/hex, and missing Rule 0-7/255 coverage. C host consumer executes all 40 vectors: exact compress/decompress bytes, Rule255 fallbacks, malformed input/residue/padding rejection, exact/one-over Rule7 profile bounds, undersized-output rejection, and failure atomicity. Fixed discovered Zephyr C parity drift: Rule0 now uses the canonical 174-bit link-local residue and 5680..5695 nibble-port encoding shared with Rule5, while decompression rejects OSCORE relabeling. Validation: python3 scripts/check-schc-compression-parity.py --build-root /Volumes/Attic/Cache/project-LICHEN/schc-parity-gate --timeout 60 => Python 706 passed; isolated Rust shared_vectors 3/3 passed; sanitizer-enabled C schc_parity 1/1 passed (40 canonical vectors). Ruff and git diff --check passed. Existing legacy lichen/tests/schc target has stale incomplete link wiring and is superseded by the fully wired generated parity consumer; it was already not a valid gate.
